answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a ripple bet on surviving 101 epochs of grading, and every yarrow settlement recomputes the raven schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 101 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
